entities.name: Seza
entities.description: Oreskan leonin scout and warrior on Theros.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: Planeswalker leonin who returned to Oreskos.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: Planeswalker, Heliod's champion, murdered by Heliod.

entities.name: Lanathos
entities.description: Human chronicler interested in leonin culture.

entities.name: Erebos
entities.description: God of the dead who set Elspeth an ordeal.

entities.name: Meletis
entities.description: Polis where Ajani spread word of Heliod's misdeeds.

entities.name: Silence of the Gods
entities.description: Event during which the gods withdrew from Theros.

events.summary: Seza, leading a patrol, meets Ajani again during the Silence of the Gods and brings him to Tethmos.
events.quote: she leveled her axe at him, asking him to identify himself

events.summary: Ajani and Brimaz greet as old friends; Ajani is directed to Lanathos for news of Elspeth.
events.quote: Ajani and Brimaz greeted each other as old friends

events.summary: Ajani, returned from Nyx unconscious with Elspeth's cloak, wakes in a healing house; Seza tells him of Pyxathor.
Brimaz defeats Ajani in all three bouts of a duel because Ajani would not fight.
events.quote: Brimaz won all three bouts over Ajani

events.summary: Ajani spreads word in Meletis of Heliod's misdeeds, then returns to Tethmos to share information with the Leonin.
events.quote: he returned to Tethmos and announced that he would share information

events.summary: Ajani tells his story; Brimaz, Lanathos and Pyxathor welcome him into their fold.

relations.quote: leaving Seza behind with her king
Ajani would remember her friendly demeanor and candid nature
a newly risen rival of Brimaz
